Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Sub:  Audio Recording of Conference Call on the Financial Results (Standalone and 
Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 
 
In continuation of our letter dated 19 October 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the 
Conference Call held on 30 October 2026, on the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and 
Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026, has been 
made available on the Company’s website at https://www.adityabirlacapital.com/investor-
relations/quarterly-results.  
 
The above is for your information, records and dissemination please.  
 
Thanking you,  
 
Yours sincerely, 
For Aditya Birla Capital Limited
